title: Sealer's Accounts
text:
Tallow seals set in Bloomhollow, by the Synod's sealer:

Mead cellar, the west way where the keepers hid their casks: 1.
Orchard chapel, the vestry behind the altar: 1.

The Great Skep was not sealed. Mother Aldith went in and would not come out, and none of us would go near enough to set the tallow.

Note for the next sealer: tallow holds against anything but a clean flame. Keep beeswax away from the seals. Keep it away from everything.
